summary.text: Hannah Bowen is a Democratic state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 6th Essex District since May 21, 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Hannah Bowen assumed office in the 6th Essex District on May 21, 2025, succeeding Jerry Parisella.
Ballotpedia lists her 2025-2026 committee assignments as the Housing, Labor and Workforce Development, State Administration and Regulatory Oversight, and Transportation joint committees.
